title: cloud-connection: install-local's cloud branch still ledgers other register refusals no restart heals (default record page, object ownership, artifact object name, sealed vocabulary), then refuses them at every boot
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5o8PE7ZtVjcor51wBZ

Filing gate: ② routed from the contract review of PR #31476 (#31392), whose record names this as an out-of-scope should-fix. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: the seat that owns `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, the cloud branch of `POST /marketplace/install-local`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `install-local lenient path register failure`, `DefaultRecordPageConflictError install-local`, `hotLoaded false refused every rehydrate` → #31392, #31296, #25366, #22695 only. None of them covers these classes.
reach: every cloud-branch install-local of a package whose register the registry refuses for a reason no restart heals, other than the three held-name classes #31296 and #31392 already refuse.
class: a · type: Bug
Grade: p2. The server seat self-graded it (Ruling-ref: the maintainer, 「定级你可以自己决定」). It is the next sibling of #31392 on the same door.

## 维护者速读

本地安装的云端分支在注册失败时，除了 #31296 / #31392 已修的三类同名冲突，还有几类注册拒绝仍走“下次重启再加载”的宽松路径：先写入安装记录，回答 200（`hotLoaded: false`），之后每次启动都被同一条规则再次拒绝，永远加载不了，门口却说成功。这几类是：默认记录页冲突、产物对象重名、对象归属冲突、默认页放错位置，以及清单服务的封闭词表拒绝。内联分支对这些已经直接回 422。要么逐类按错误码识别后拒绝，要么一次性决定宽松路径本身的去留。

## What is wrong (read in the tree by the #31476 reviewer, not measured)

The cloud branch's lenient path ledgers these refusals and answers `200`, `hotLoaded: false`. Each is then refused again at every rehydrate, because the same holder is still present:
- `DefaultRecordPageConflictError` (`DEFAULT_RECORD_PAGE_CONFLICT`)
- `ArtifactObjectNameConflictError` (`DUPLICATE_ARTIFACT_OBJECT_NAME`)
- `ObjectOwnershipConflictError` (`OBJECT_OWNERSHIP_CONFLICT`)
- `MisplacedDefaultPageError`
- the manifest service's sealed-vocabulary refusals: unresolved picklist references and unbound action targets.

The inline branch already answers all of these 422. The #22695 comment in the cloud branch still calls the lenient path's fate "a separate decision".

## Expected

- The cloud branch refuses each of these the way the inline branch does: 422, nothing written to the ledger. Either extend the code + name recogniser from #31476 (`refusesNameHeldElsewhere`), or decide the lenient path's fate once for every pre-write register refusal. Choosing between those is the dev's design call, with the four-axis analysis in the PR. A remaining lenient case must be named, with the restart that heals it.
- Pins: each class answers 422 and leaves the ledger unchanged. Measure red on main first. CONTROL: a register failure that a restart does heal, if one exists, keeps its current answer.

Related: #31392 / PR #31476, #31296 / PR #31388, #25366, #22695.
